newsitem.title: ESTONIA: C.BANK CHIEF SEES NO NEED FOR ECONOMIC CHANGE.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK CHIEF SEES NO NEED FOR ECONOMIC CHANGE.

text.p: The head of Estonia's central bank, Vahur Kraft, on Friday said he saw no reason to change Estonia's economic policy and highlighted the importance of European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
Speaking at a conference of the Baltic central banks in the coastal town of Parnu, Kraft said his country must carry on with the path already pursued.
"There is no need for Estonia to change the economic policy princples that have been established so far. We must go with the structural and economic reforms," he said in a speech.
Kraft also said that EMU was a key factor for the Baltic states and all transition economies.

"It would be extremely hard to imagine any future developments in our geographical neighbourhood overshadowing the influence on the Baltic economies of the continuing European economic integration and the European monetary union," he said.
